column1: # Known file extensions and their readings (project-owner decision 2026-10-22): a file name
# with one of these extensions reads in full in English speech output (report.pdf report
# dot p d f). The value is @say items: s: letter names, w: words, c: a number.
# Address words (project-owner decision 2026-10-22): common English words and given names of
# three letters or more read as words in a URL or an e-mail address (transit.org/live, jess.m@);
